name: Night Owl
bio: I do my best thinking when the office is empty.

name: Mentor
blurb: Half their day is somebody else's question — and everyone learns faster for it.
bio: Pull up a chair, I'll walk you through it.

name: Perfectionist
blurb: Slower, but they learn something from every pass.
bio: It's nearly done. I just want one more look at it.

name: Speedster
blurb: Fast hands, shallow roots — output up, learning down.
bio: Ship it, see what breaks, fix that.

name: Social Butterfly
blurb: Knows everyone, happier for it, and harder to tempt away.
bio: Coffee? I'll get the whole floor to come.

name: Loner
blurb: Headphones on, output up — and no reason to stay if a rival calls.
bio: Put the ticket in the queue and I'll get to it.

name: Flight Risk
blurb: Always half-listening to recruiters. Loses patience fast.
bio: I'm here for now. Ask me again in six months.

name: Loyalist
blurb: Will ride out a rough year, and turn a rival down flat.
bio: I signed up for the whole thing, not the good bits.

name: Jokester
blurb: Gets less done, but the whole room is in a better mood.
bio: I've got a bit about the standup. Literally about the standup.

name: Grumbler
blurb: Productive, unhappy, and contagious about it.
bio: This is the third time we've rewritten this.

name: Prodigy
blurb: Enormous output, learns fast, bores easily — and everyone wants them.
bio: Give me the hard one. The other one puts me to sleep.

name: Workhorse
blurb: Steady, tireless, and slow to complain.
bio: Tell me what's on fire and I'll start there.

name: Fragile
blurb: Brilliant on a good week. Bad weeks land hard.
bio: I'm fine. It's been a lot lately, that's all.

name: Showman
blurb: Always on somebody's podcast. Lifts the room and the company's name.
bio: I already told three conferences we're launching this quarter.
